description: Worker entered vessel without gas testing during scheduled maintenance
Scaffolding at height lacked edge protection and fall arrest anchor points
Technician performed hot work near flammable storage without a hot work permit
Lockout/tagout was incomplete before valve maintenance energy source remained live
Atmospheric hazard detected near storage tank no standby attendant present during entry
Vehicle reversed in an active work zone without a spotter line of fire exposure
Rigging equipment used for lift had not been inspected load path crossed personnel walkway
